summary:
Completed comprehensive redesign of the selected element (footer#about-us-section) and its child components to remove generic AI-generated aesthetics:
1. Replaced harsh neon-green headers and generic pills with an award-winning Obsidian Noir (#12100E) and Champagne Gold (#C5A880) luxury palette.
2. Redesigned PremiumSocialBar into an architectural Concierge & Direct Ordering section with authentic brand colors and zero pill badges.
3. Transformed DeveloperFooter from a clashing cream box with heart emoji into a dark luxury atelier colophon.
4. Added official FSSAI & Udyam trust plaque and background architectural brand watermark.
5. All validation and security regression suites pass with 0 errors.
